_scenario: Cross-timezone — Toronto operator, vendor `company.timezone` reports America/Vancouver, individual shift UTC values land on different local business_dates per zone
_note: The /company endpoint is documented (api_consumed.md) as the source of timezone + business-day rollover hints. This fixture pairs a /company response carrying `timezone: America/Vancouver` with a /shifts page whose UTC timestamps fall on different business_dates depending on whether the resolver picks the Humanity-reported timezone or the operator's restaurant_locations.iana_timezone (Toronto). Per HP #4 / time guardrails, restaurant-local timing wins — operator's location_id timezone is authoritative; the vendor company timezone is metadata.

data._resolver_note: America/Toronto: 23:30 EDT 2026-05-04 -> 07:30 EDT 2026-05-05 (in_time business_date = 2026-05-04). America/Vancouver: 20:30 PDT 2026-05-04 -> 04:30 PDT 2026-05-05 (in_time business_date = 2026-05-04 still). DIFFERENT pre-rollover handling: with rollover_hour=4, Toronto opens 04:00 EDT and rolls 04:00 EDT next day -> in_time 23:30 EDT lands in 2026-05-04 service period; Vancouver rollover at 04:00 PDT -> in_time 20:30 PDT also lands in 2026-05-04 service period. Same business_date here; resolver discrepancy hits when in_time is 06:00 UTC (next case).

America/Toronto: 02:00 EDT 2026-05-05 -> 10:00 EDT 2026-05-05 (in_time pre-rollover_hour=4 -> business_date 2026-05-04). America/Vancouver: 23:00 PDT 2026-05-04 -> 07:00 PDT 2026-05-05 (in_time pre-rollover_hour=4 -> business_date 2026-05-04). NOTE: business_date matches both ways here too because rollover applies. The bug surface this fixture pins is: if the resolver MISTAKENLY consults Humanity company.timezone instead of restaurant_locations.iana_timezone, business_date/SPLH bucketing silently mis-aligns when the vendor and operator zones diverge by 3+ hours.

America/Toronto: 04:00 EDT 2026-05-05 -> 12:00 EDT (post-rollover -> business_date 2026-05-05). America/Vancouver: 01:00 PDT 2026-05-05 -> 09:00 PDT (pre-rollover at 04:00 PDT -> business_date 2026-05-04). DIVERGENCE: same UTC instant lands on DIFFERENT business_dates depending on which timezone the resolver picks. The Toronto operator MUST see business_date=2026-05-05; if the resolver consults company.timezone (Vancouver), it incorrectly returns 2026-05-04. This fixture pins that the resolver picks restaurant_locations.iana_timezone (operator authority) and ignores Humanity company.timezone.
